resumeText:
Vikram Joshi | Mumbai | vikram.joshi@example.com

SUMMARY
Security leader with 18 years in security operations, architecture and governance in banking and insurance.

EXPERIENCE
Head of Information Security, Arabian Sea General Insurance, Mumbai (2019 - present)
- Wrote and run the information security strategy and three-year security roadmap.
- Own the cyber risk register and approve risk treatment plans.
- Led the programme to meet IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines and CERT-In directions.
- Set zero trust and enterprise security architecture standards for cloud and identity.
- Led incident response for two major incidents and reported them to CERT-In within six hours.
- Run the ISMS and keep ISO 27001 certification across all offices.
- Brief the board risk committee every quarter on cyber risk.
- Managed a team of 30 across SOC, security engineering and GRC.
- Use stakeholder communication with the CTO, CRO and regulators.

Security Architect, Lakeview Bank, Mumbai (2012 - 2019)
- Designed network and identity security for core banking.

Security Engineer, Konkan Infotech, Pune (2008 - 2012)

CERTIFICATIONS
CISSP, CISM

EDUCATION
BE Electronics, VJTI Mumbai, 2008
